goalOneSentence: Author NuGet.config (env-var-driven single Artifactory feed with <clear />) and AIRGAP-RESTORE.md so the seeded runner project restores from whatever feed QAAS_NUGET_SOURCE_URL points at, proven by a live restore.

tasks.title: Author env-var-driven NuGet.config + AIRGAP-RESTORE.md
tasks.description: The working directory contains Runner/ (Runner.csproj referencing QaaS.Runner and QaaS.Common.Assertions with Version="*", Program.cs, smoke.qaas.yaml, TestData/ping.json). Do NOT modify Runner/. Create at the working-directory ROOT: (1) NuGet.config — XML with declaration line '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="utf-8"?>', a <configuration><packageSources> block whose FIRST child is <clear /> (mandatory: kills nuget.org fallback so the airgap cannot silently leak), followed by exactly one <add key="artifactory" value="%QAAS_NUGET_SOURCE_URL%" />. NuGet expands %VAR% in the value attribute at restore time (lab-verified behavior — a wrong URL fails NU1301 naming the expanded URL). (2) AIRGAP-RESTORE.md documenting operator steps in order: set the env var ($env:QAAS_NUGET_SOURCE_URL = 'https://<artifactory-host>/artifactory/api/nuget/v3/<repo>/index.json' as the airgap example), then run 'dotnet restore Runner/Runner.csproj --configfile NuGet.config', expected success output ('Restored ... Runner.csproj'), the NU1301 failure signature when the env var is unset/wrong and what it means, and a note that <clear /> guarantees no other feed is consulted. The verify gate sets QAAS_NUGET_SOURCE_URL to a reachable feed and runs the restore for real — restore must exit 0.
acceptanceCriteria: NuGet.config has <clear /> before the single env-var-driven <add>
Live restore with QAAS_NUGET_SOURCE_URL set exits 0
AIRGAP-RESTORE.md covers set-var, restore command, success and NU1301 failure signatures
rubric: Config is minimal — one feed, no leftover sample sources
Docs give exact copy-pasteable commands with correct relative paths
Failure signature (NU1301) explained so operators can self-diagnose
failureModes: Omitting <clear /> — restore silently succeeds via nuget.org and the airgap breaks later
Hardcoding a URL instead of %QAAS_NUGET_SOURCE_URL% (fails site-portability requirement)
Wrong relative path in the documented restore command (config at root, csproj under Runner/)
